name: Slider field
summary: Drag or arrow-key one value across a known range (zoom, opacity, an overlay amount) in the antd Slider look, without antd.
highlights: One thumb on the antd Slider look: brand track, gray-30 rail, 14px handle
input while dragging, change on release: antd onChange and onChangeComplete
A value label formatter that is also the spoken value
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-slider>, defined once and imported unchanged by React and Vue: the framework-free counterpart of a single-thumb antd Slider, so an app can drop antd for its sliders. It draws what the shared sliderTheme draws (4px gray-30 rail, brand track, 14px white handle with a 2px brand ring, gray-40 rail and darker track on hover). Drag anywhere on the rail, or focus the handle and use the arrow keys, Page Up / Page Down, Home and End. The value is a number between min and max, snapped to step; `input` fires on every change while dragging and `change` once on release. `valueText` formats the value label above the handle and the handle's aria-valuetext (a zoom of 1.5 reads 150%). The handle is the role="slider"; the element is form-associated and <aha-form-item> reads and resets it. When the exact number matters, pair it with an <aha-input-number> on the same value (a 1fr 88px grid). Range (two thumbs), marks and vertical stay on the antd Slider composite.
codeNote: antd Slider → <aha-slider>: value / onChange → `value` (a number property; the attribute is its string) + the `input` event (fires on every value change while dragging and on each key press) · onChangeComplete → the `change` event (fires once on release, and on each key press) · e.detail.value is a number · min / max / step → the same attributes (default 0 / 100 / 1; a decimal step such as 0.01 snaps exactly) · disabled → disabled · tooltip={{ formatter }} → the `valueText` property, a function (value) => string, also used as aria-valuetext · tooltip={{ open: false }} → tooltip="false" · ariaLabelledByForHandle → aria-labelledby (ids resolved to their text across the shadow root and re-read on focus) · ariaLabelForHandle → aria-label · keyboard ← → ↑ ↓, Home / End → the same keys; Page Up / Page Down step a tenth of the range · range, marks, dots, vertical, reverse, included=false: not supported, use the antd Slider composite. React 18: set `value` and `valueText` through a ref and listen with ref.current.addEventListener('input' | 'change', …), since React 18 does not wire CustomEvents; pass a boolean as present or absent ({...(disabled ? { disabled: '' } : {})}); disabled="false" reads as off. React 19 can use the element directly. Vue binds it natively (:value.prop, :value-text.prop, @input, @change).

spec.label: Rail
spec.value: 4px · #F1F1F1 (gray-30), pill ends; #E3E3E3 (gray-40) on hover; the control is 24px tall (the touch target), full width, 7px inset each side for the handle

spec.label: Track
spec.value: brand #E70E68 from min to the value; #DB005B (color-primary-hover) on hover

spec.label: Handle
spec.value: 14px white circle, 2px #E70E68 ring; hover and drag scale it to 16px with a #DB005B ring; keyboard focus adds a 4px #E70E68@30% ring (focus-ring-soft) outside it

spec.label: Value label
spec.value: the Tooltip bubble: #1A1A1A (bg-dark), white 12/18 text, radius 6, padding 6 10, arrow, 2px above the control and centred on the handle; shown while dragging, on mouse hover of the handle and on keyboard focus (never on a tap's leftover focus); tooltip="false" hides it. It sits inside the element, so a parent with overflow hidden needs room above the slider

spec.label: Disabled
spec.value: #B5B5B5 (icon-disabled) track and handle ring, gray-30 rail, no hover, no label, not focusable, cursor not-allowed

spec.label: Right to left
spec.value: in a dir="rtl" context the rail fills from the right and ArrowLeft / ArrowRight swap; ArrowUp / ArrowDown keep their meaning

spec.label: With InputNumber
spec.value: when the exact number matters: a grid of 1fr 88px, 8px gap, items centred: <aha-slider> then <aha-input-number style="width:100%"> on the same min, max and value; each one's input event sets the other's value

spec.label: From antd
spec.value: a single-thumb antd Slider under sliderTheme renders the same rail, track and handle; tooltip.formatter becomes valueText, onChangeComplete becomes the change event, ariaLabelledByForHandle becomes aria-labelledby

props.name: value
props.desc: The value. The property reads a number, clamped to min / max and snapped to step; the attribute is its string. Set null or '' to go back to min

props.name: min / max
props.desc: The bounds; a max below min reads as min

props.name: step
props.desc: The step a drag snaps to and each arrow key moves; a decimal step (0.01) snaps exactly. Page Up / Page Down move a tenth of the range, rounded to the step

props.name: valueText
props.desc: Formats the value label and the handle's aria-valuetext (antd tooltip.formatter); a property, not an attribute. Without it the label shows the number

props.name: tooltip
props.desc: tooltip="false" hides the value label (antd tooltip={{ open: false }})

props.name: disabled
props.desc: Not interactive, grey track and handle, out of the tab order; disabled="false" reads as off

props.name: aria-label / aria-labelledby
props.desc: Name the handle (antd ariaLabelForHandle / ariaLabelledByForHandle); aria-labelledby ids are resolved to their text across the shadow root and re-read on focus. A <label for> on the host works too

props.name: aria-describedby
props.desc: Ids describing the slider, resolved on the handle

props.name: name
props.desc: Form field name: the element is form-associated, submits the value, resets to its first value and follows a disabled fieldset

props.name: input
props.desc: Composed; fires on every value change: each move while dragging and each key press (antd onChange)

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed; fires once when a drag that moved the value is released, and on each key press (antd onChangeComplete)

a11y.role: the handle is role="slider" with aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and, with valueText, aria-valuetext; aria-disabled when disabled; aria-invalid follows status
a11y.keyboard: ArrowRight / ArrowUp step up, ArrowLeft / ArrowDown step down (left and right swap right to left), Page Up / Page Down move a tenth of the range, Home / End go to min / max; the handle is the one tab stop
a11y.note: Name it with a visible label (aria-labelledby) or aria-label; give a percent or unit readout through valueText so the spoken value matches the label.

whenToUse.when: one approximate value across a known range where feel beats an exact number: zoom, opacity, an overlay amount
the same value where the exact number also matters: the slider beside an 88px number field
a range with two thumbs, marks or a vertical rail, or an antd screen not moving off antd yet
a rating on the audience phone, coloured by the deck

opinion.note: Label the slider with a noun phrase and give it a readout (valueText or a paired number field) when the number means something.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the DS V3 Slider single-thumb look as sliderTheme renders it on antd v6 (rail, track, handle, hover); the value label is the Tooltip bubble.
